data.transform:
return `
  SELECT
    t.billingaddress,
    t.currency,
    t.duedate,
    t.entity,
    t.id,
    t.memo,
    t.number,
    t.ordreceived,
    t.outsourced,
    t.status,
    t.shipcarrier,
    t.shipdate,
    t.shippingaddress,
    t.trandate,
    t.tranid,
    t.transferlocation,
    t.type,
    t.void,
    l.actualshipdate,
    l.foreignamount,
    l.expectedreceiptdate,
    l.expectedshipdate,
    l.id lineid,
    l.isbillable,
    l.isclosed,
    l.isfullyshipped,
    l.item,
    l.linesequencenumber,
    l.location,
    l.mainline,
    l.memo linememo,
    l.quantity,
    l.rate,
    l.quantityshiprecv,
    l.uniquekey,
    l.units,
    l.subsidiary,
    l.taxline,
    l.transactionlinetype
  FROM transaction t
  LEFT JOIN transactionline l 
    ON t.id=l.transaction 
  WHERE
    t.id = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
    AND 
    t.type='TrnfrOrd'
    AND
    t.status != 'A'
    AND
    l.taxline='F'
    AND 
    ( BUILTIN.DF(l.transactionlinetype)='Transfer Order: Item' OR BUILTIN.DF(l.transactionlinetype) IS NULL )
`
